text.p: Italian bonds and Btp futures ended at the day's highs, boosted by other higher debt markets in line with firmer T-bonds after a raft of weak U.S. data triggered rallies, traders said.

The June Btp Liffe contract erased earlier weakness and closed well above 127.00 on the wave of bullish sentiment and traders said although EMU uncertainties and domestic political worries continued to cloud the Italian market, Btps should be able to carry on gaining on the back of other foreign markets.
But some traders said the rebound was purely technical and may be insufficient to signal a current range breakout.
